records.text: Owens said Justin Baldoni had faced established power, including The New York Times and WME, and characterized his treatment as cruel and done out of sport.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He was up against an established power. I mean, it was in New York Times. It was WME. ... It was the most powerful PR people in the world, the most famous woman in the world. But what was done to him was positively cruel and it was done out of sport.
